The mean (SD) PASI score, sPGA, BSA, and DLQI was 23.2 (9.2), 3.6 (0.7), 29.9 (16.3), and 14.4 (6.7), respectively. The majority of patients had an sPGA score of 3 (205 patients; 53.4%) or 4 (125 patients; 32.6%). sPGA scores of 4 or 5 were observed in slightly more patients in the Bmab1200 group than the Stelara group. The majority of patients did not have previous exposure to biologic-based therapies (331 patients; 86.2%) and did not have concomitant psoriatic arthritis (322 patients; 83.9%).
